|errata_history=Versions of [[Combat Readiness (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 2, slip 30 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “USED: Place on top of your Reserve Deck. STARTING: If your starting location was a battleground system, deploy up to two related locations (one must be a site) and up to two Effects (plus one Effect for each additional battleground you have on table) that are always A. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•30” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Combat Readiness (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 30), in the Committee's Remaster template: “STARTING: If your starting location was a battleground site, deploy up to two related locations (one must be a system) with < 4 total [Dark Side Force] and up to three Effects that are always immune to Alter from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
